question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Soaring** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Soaring **means to rise rapidly and strongly, which is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank. (तेजी से और मजबूती से बढ़ना) • **For example**: *The price of Bitcoin is soaring in the market.* • In this context, "soaring" is used as a response to the statement "Socrates is flying" to indicate that Socrates is not literally flying like a bird but rather excelling or rising to new heights in a metaphorical or figurative sense. • The word "soaring" suggests that Socrates is achieving great success or making remarkable progress in some aspect of his life or endeavours. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** • **Sluggish **means slow-moving or inactive. (धीमी गति से चलने वाला या निष्क्रिय) • **Pertinent **means relevant or applicable to a particular matter. (किसी विशेष मामले से संबंधित या लागू) • **Redundant **means not needed or superfluous. (आवश्यकता नहीं या अतिश्योक्तिपूर्ण) 43:Tb00, The correct answer is: **While**
